hero_kpi_rationale: Dominion Energy faces significant interest rate risk exposure, with interest rate derivatives valued at $10.7 billion and a $459 million impact on fair value. This exposure is existential for the cost of capital and represents a major risk factor in a volatile rate environment.
company_description: Dominion Energy, Inc. provides regulated electricity and natural gas services in the United States. It operates through Dominion Energy Virginia, Dominion Energy South Carolina, and Contracted Energy segments. The Dominion Energy Virginia segment engages in the generation, distribution, and transmission of electricity to approximately 2.8 million residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental customers in Virginia and North Carolina. The Dominion Energy South Carolina segment generates, transmits, and distributes electricity to approximately 0.8 million customers in the central, southern, and southwestern portions of South Carolina; and distributes natural gas to approximately 0.5 million residential, commercial, and industrial customers in South Carolina. The Contracted Energy segment is involved in the nonregulated long-term contracted renewable electric generation fleet and renewable natural gas facilities. As of December 31, 2025, the company's portfolio of assets included approximately 30.7 GW of electric generating capacity, 10,800 miles of electric transmission lines, and 80,400 miles of electric distribution lines. The company was formerly known as Dominion Resources

kpis.name: Interest Rate Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Value of interest rate derivatives exposing the company to interest rate fluctuations
kpis.description: Dominion Energy holds a significant portfolio of interest rate derivatives. Changes in interest rates can materially impact earnings and the fair value of these derivatives, especially given substantial variable-rate debt.

kpis.name: Foreign Exchange Risk on CVOW Project
kpis.explanation: Value of fixed-price contracts denominated in foreign currencies (euros and kronor) for the CVOW project
kpis.description: Dominion Energy manages the CVOW commercial project with contracts denominated in euros and Swedish kronor totaling approximately $2.6 billion and 5.1 billion kronor. Exposure to U.S. dollar fluctuations may result in foreign exchange losses despite partial hedging.

kpis.name: Commodity Price Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Exposure to fluctuations in electricity, natural gas, and other energy product prices
kpis.description: Dominion Energy is exposed to changes in electricity, natural gas, and other energy prices, which may impact its derivatives and margins. The quantified impact ranges between $915 million and $918 million depending on market scenarios.

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio Market Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Sensitivity of retirement and nuclear decommissioning investment assets to financial market fluctuations
kpis.description: Investment portfolios for retirement and nuclear decommissioning, whose assets generate $1.2 billion in returns, are sensitive to financial market movements. A 0.25% decline in returns could impact the company by $28 to $31 million.

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to fluctuations in electricity, gas, and other energy prices, which may impact its derivatives and margins.
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in the 10-K with quantified impacts ($915M to $918M) and significant exposure to electricity and gas markets. The language emphasizes direct sensitivity to price volatility. The Macro category is weighted as significant.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: Changes in interest rates can significantly impact earnings and the fair value of interest rate derivatives, particularly given high variable-rate debt.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is prominently highlighted with substantial derivative exposure ($10.7 billion) and a $459M impact on fair value. The intensity of language and growing exposures indicate an existential threat to the cost of capital.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.summary: Exposure to foreign currency contracts exposes the company to losses if the U.S. dollar fluctuates.
risks.score_rationale: Present for the CVOW project with contracts in euros and kronor ($2.6 billion), and a $35M impact on fair value. Although partially hedged, the risk is recurring and tied to strategic projects.

risks.title: Investment Risk
risks.summary: Investment portfolios for retirement and nuclear decommissioning are sensitive to financial market fluctuations.
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to pension assets and nuclear decommissioning funds, with a $28M to $31M impact from a 0.25% decline. The size of assets ($1.2 billion in returns) and market sensitivity justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.summary: Although counterparties are exposed, strict credit policies limit default risk.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned but deemed unlikely to have a material impact according to management. Credit and collateral policies are robust, mitigating risk despite counterparty presence.

ai_positioning.summary: Dominion Energy does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company does not use AI as a differentiating or strategic element in its operations.
